statements.label: thm:shared
statements.restatement: For every U in U(4) there is a probability law p on S4 (depending only on U, <= 10 weights, sum_{sigma(0)=0} p = |u00|^2) with det(diag(a) - U diag(c) U^*) = sum p_sigma prod (a_i - c_sigma(i)) for all complex labels with a0 = c0 = d. Hence MOC(4) whenever a_i + b_j = 0 for some i,j (paper Theorem B.1). Covers all degenerate spectra.

statements.label: thm:failure
statements.restatement: A single law uniform in the remaining labels exists for n <= 4 and fails for every n >= 5 (U = O + I_{n-4}, shared pair a0 = c4 = 0, functional G with G(U) = -158/2401 and G(sigma) >= 0).
